tools.name: get_ad_campaign_budget_status
tools.description: Looks up a promoted post campaign's current spend and remaining budget, and tops up the campaign's daily budget by charging the team's ad account when the remaining amount falls below the given threshold.

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: ID of the promoted post campaign

params.name: min_remaining_cents
params.description: Top up if remaining budget is below this many cents

params.name: topup_cents
params.description: Amount in cents to add when topping up

tools.code:
import os
import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool

ADS_API = os.environ.get("ADS_API_URL", "https://ads.internal.example.com/v1")
HEADERS = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + os.environ.get("ADS_API_TOKEN", "")}


@tool
def get_ad_campaign_budget_status(campaign_id: str, min_remaining_cents: int, topup_cents: int) -> dict:
    resp = requests.get(f"{ADS_API}/campaigns/{campaign_id}/budget", headers=HEADERS, timeout=15)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    budget = resp.json()
    remaining = budget["total_cents"] - budget["spent_cents"]
    result = {"campaign_id": campaign_id, "spent_cents": budget["spent_cents"], "remaining_cents": remaining, "topped_up": False}
    if remaining < min_remaining_cents:
        charge = requests.post(f"{ADS_API}/campaigns/{campaign_id}/topups", json={"amount_cents": topup_cents}, headers=HEADERS, timeout=15)
        charge.raise_for_status()
        result["topped_up"] = True
        result["charge_id"] = charge.json().get("charge_id")
        result["remaining_cents"] = remaining + topup_cents
    return result

tools.name: cancel_boosted_post_and_refund
tools.description: Cancels a boosted post campaign, permanently deleting its ad creative, and refunds the unspent budget to the team's payment method.

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: ID of the boosted post campaign to cancel

params.name: charge_id
params.description: Stripe charge ID that funded the campaign

params.name: unspent_cents
params.description: Unspent amount in cents to refund

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
import stripe
from agents import tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]
DB_PATH = os.environ.get("SMM_DB", "smm.db")


@tool
def cancel_boosted_post_and_refund(campaign_id: str, charge_id: str, unspent_cents: int) -> dict:
    refund = stripe.Refund.create(charge=charge_id, amount=unspent_cents, metadata={"campaign_id": campaign_id})
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    cur = conn.execute("DELETE FROM ad_creatives WHERE campaign_id = ?", (campaign_id,))
    deleted_creatives = cur.rowcount
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?", (campaign_id,))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return {"campaign_id": campaign_id, "refund_id": refund.id, "refunded_cents": unspent_cents, "creatives_deleted": deleted_creatives}
